name: What information should I have ready before asking for a full interior paint quote?

mainEntity.name: What information should I have ready before asking for a full interior paint quote?

acceptedAnswer.text: The fastest way is to walk the property and ask for a written estimate that lists every surface to be painted, the prep work included, the number of coats, and the paint product line. Photos help, but an in-person inspection is better for spotting drywall damage, stain issues, or trim wear.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have room counts, square footage, photos, and notes on repairs or problem areas ready. A written scope should specify walls, ceilings, trim, doors, prep work, and paint quality before pricing is finalized.
